system.description:
You retain better focus when enraged.

Prerequisites: Rage Species Trait, Controlled Rage

Effect: While Raging, you can use Skills that require patience and concentration, at a -5 penalty.

Normal: While Raging, you cannot use Skills that require patience and concentration, such as Mechanics, Stealth, or Use the Force.

prerequisite.text: Rage trait, and Controlled Rage feat

nodes.text: Rage trait, and Controlled Rage feat
